examName: Maharashtra Education Service, Group B (Collegiate Branch) - Chemistry
examNameMr: महाराष्ट्र शिक्षण सेवा, गट-ब (महाविद्यालयीन शाखा) - रसायनशास्त्र
examPattern: Written Examination / Screening Test followed by Document Verification or Interview

topics: Idea of De Broglie matter waves, Heisenberg uncertainty principle
Atomic orbitals, Schrodinger wave equation, significance of wave functions, quantum numbers, radial and angular wave functions and probability distribution curves, shapes of s, p, d orbitals
Aufbau and Pauli exclusion principles, Hund's multiplicity rule, electronic configurations of the elements, effective nuclear charge
Covalent Bond: Valence bond theory and its limitations, directional characteristics of covalent bond, various types of hybridizations and shapes of simple inorganic molecules and ions
Valence shell electron pair repulsion (VSEPR) theory, molecular orbital theory and its applications to homonuclear and heteronuclear diatomic molecules
Ionic Solids: Ionic structures, radius ratio effect and coordination number, limitation of radius ratio rule, lattice defects, semiconductors, lattice energy and Born-Haber cycle
Weak Interactions: Hydrogen bonding, Van der Waals forces
s-Block and p-Block Elements: Comparative study, diagonal relationships, salient features of hydrides, oxides, and halides
Chemistry of Elements of First, Second and Third Transition Series: General characteristics, comparative treatment with their 3d-analogues
Coordination Compounds: Werner's coordination theory, effective atomic number concept, chelates, nomenclature, isomerism, and valence bond theory of transition metal complexes

units.unitTitle: Metal-ligand Bonding in Transition Metal Complexes
topics: Limitations of valence bond theory, an elementary idea of crystal-field theory, crystal field splitting in octahedral, tetrahedral and square planar complexes, factors affecting the crystal-field parameters

Magnetic Properties of Transition Metal Complexes: Types of magnetic behaviour, methods of determining magnetic susceptibility, spin-only formula, L-S coupling, orbital contribution to magnetic moments
Electron Spectra of Transition Metal Complexes: Types of electronic transitions, selection rules for d-d transitions, spectroscopic ground states, spectrochemical series
Chemistry of Lanthanide Elements: Electronic structure, oxidation states and ionic radii, lanthanide contraction, complex formation, occurrence and isolation
Chemistry of Actinides: General features and chemistry of actinides, chemistry of separation of Np, Pu and Am from U, similarities between later actinides and later lanthanides
Organometallic Chemistry: A brief account of metal-ethylenic complexes and homogeneous hydrogenation, mononuclear and polynuclear carbonyls and the nature of bonding in metal carbonyls

units.unitTitle: Bioinorganic Chemistry, Acids, Bases and States of Matter
units.unitTitleMr: बायोइनरॅगानिक रसायनशास्त्र, आम्ल, आम्लारी आणि द्रव्याची अवस्था
topics: Essential and trace elements in biological processes, metalloporphyrins with special reference to haemoglobin and myoglobin
Acids and Bases: Arrhenius, Bronsted-Lowry, Lux-Flood, solvent system and Lewis concepts
Non-aqueous Solvents: Physical properties, types of solvents and reactions in non-aqueous solvents with reference to liquid NH3 and liquid SO2
Gaseous States: Postulates of kinetic theory of gases, deviation from ideal behaviour, Van der Waals equations of state, molecular velocities and liquefaction of gases
Liquid State: Intermolecular forces, structure of liquids, liquid crystals and their classification
Solid State: Space lattice, unit cell, laws of crystallography, X-ray diffraction by crystals and Bragg's equation
Colloidal State: Definition, classification, properties, stability of colloids, emulsions, gels, and micelles
Chemical Kinetics and Catalysis: Rate of a reaction, factors influencing rate, zero order, first order, second order, pseudo order, half life and mean life
Thermodynamics: First, second, and third laws of thermodynamics, internal energy, enthalpy, entropy, Gibbs and Helmholtz functions
Thermochemistry: Bond dissociation energy, Kirchhoff's equation
Chemical Equilibrium: Equilibrium constant and free energy, Le Chatelier's principle, Clapeyron and Clausius-Clapeyron equations
Phase Equilibrium: Phase, component, degree of freedom, Gibbs phase rule, phase diagrams of water and carbon dioxide
Environmental Safety and Waste Disposal: Air, water, soil and noise pollutions, industrial toxins organic and inorganic treatment

units.unitTitle: Structure, Bonding and Reaction Mechanism in Organic Chemistry
units.unitTitleMr: सेंद्रिय रसायनशास्त्रातील रचना, बंधन आणि अभिक्रिया यंत्रणा
topics: Hybridizations, bond lengths, bond angles, bond energy, resonance, hyperconjugation, inductive effects, reactive intermediates
Stereochemistry of Organic Compounds: Optical isomerism, geometrical isomerism, conformations of cyclohexane, Baeyer's strain theory
Absorption Spectroscopy: UV, IR, Rotational, and NMR spectroscopy, principles and applications
Alkenes, Dienes and Alkynes: Methods of formation, mechanisms of dehydration, elimination rules, chemical reactions, polymerization

units.unitTitle: Arenes, Alcohols, Carbonyl Compounds and Organic Synthesis
units.unitTitleMr: एरिन्स, अल्कोहोल, कार्बोनील संयुगे आणि सेंद्रिय संश्लेषण
topics: Arenes and Aromaticity: Huckel rule, aromatic electrophilic substitutions, activating and deactivating substituents, Birch reduction
Alcohols, Phenols, Aldehydes, Ketones, and Carboxylic Acids: Preparation, chemical reactions, rearrangements, and reduction mechanisms
Organic Compounds of Nitrogen: Amines, synthetic transformations of aryl diazonium salt, azo coupling
Organosulphur and Heterocyclic Compounds: Thiols, thioethers, sulphonic acids, pyridine, indole, quinoline, and isoquinoline
Carbohydrates, Amino Acids, Peptides, Proteins, Nucleic Acids, Synthetic Polymers, Synthetic Dyes, and Green Chemistry

units.unitTitleMr: विद्युत रसायनशास्त्र, क्वांटम मेकॅनिक्स आणि प्रकाश रसायनशास्त्र
topics: Migration of ions, Kohlrausch law, Ostwald's dilution law, Debye-Huckel-Onsager equation, applications of conductivity measurements
Types of reversible electrodes, Nernst equation, electrochemical series, galvanic cells, EMF measurement, pH determination, buffers, corrosion, energy sources and fuel cells
Elementary Quantum Mechanics: Hamiltonian operator, Schrodinger wave equation, particle in a one-dimensional box
Photochemistry: Laws of photochemistry, fluorescence, phosphorescence, quantum yield, photosensitized reactions
Computers: Basic concepts, use of computers in chemistry, computer simulations and molecular modelling
